note: Taking dependency 1.1 (a <= n_i for every i) as correct, this node multiplies that inequality through by p_i. The hypothesis of the enclosing conjecture states the p_i are positive reals, so p_i > 0 for each i, and multiplication of an inequality between reals by a positive real preserves the direction: a <= n_i implies p_i a <= p_i n_i. The step is a single application of order-compatibility of multiplication in an ordered field, applied pointwise for each fixed i, with no quantifier interchange or summation involved. Note the conclusion would in fact survive under the weaker hypothesis p_i >= 0 (with equality on both sides when p_i = 0), so the step does not rest on strictness; but strict positivity is what the ambient hypotheses supply and it is sufficient. No unstated lemmas are smuggled in, and the range of i matches that of 1.1.
